findings.evidence: Average.lean:102-105 and 110-113 are identical three-tactic blocks; the hypothesis shape is forced by `theorem circleAverage_congr_sphere ... (sphere c |R|)` (mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/CircleAverage.lean:153) and `circleAverage_nonneg_of_nonneg ... (∀ x ∈ Metric.sphere c |R|, 0 ≤ f x)` (ibid.:304-306).
findings.fix: Factor it out, e.g. in `GTMD/Transverse.lean`: `lemma norm_repr_eq_of_mem_sphere {kT : ℝ} {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) |kT|) : ‖Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr z‖ = |kT| := by rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]; rwa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] at hz`, then both proofs become `refine Real.circleAverage_… fun z hz => _ (norm_repr_eq_of_mem_sphere hz)`.
findings.issue: The translation from Mathlib's `Metric.sphere 0 |kT|` hypothesis to `‖repr z‖ = |kT|` is repeated verbatim in `circleAverageTransverse_congr_sphere` (lines 104-105) and `circleAverageTransverse_nonneg_of_nonneg` (lines 112-113). It is the reusable core of the transport and every further transported lemma (e.g. the announced `integrateTransverse_azimuthalAverage`, or a `_le_of_le_circle`) needs it again.

findings.evidence: Transverse.lean:72-75; mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/CircleIntegral.lean:163 `circleMap_neg_radius : circleMap c (-r) x = circleMap c r (x + π)`; `Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI_repr_apply` is `@[simp]` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/PiL2.lean:883), as are `radialVector_apply_zero`/`_one` here.
findings.fix: Replace `congr 1` with an explicit rewrite: `have hc : circleMap 0 (-kT) θ = -circleMap 0 kT θ := by simp [circleMap_zero]` then `rw [radialVector, hc, map_neg, radialVector]`; or prove componentwise on this file's own `@[simp]` lemmas: `ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [neg_mul]`.
findings.issue: `radialVector_neg_radius` discharges its only real content (`circleMap 0 (-kT) θ = -circleMap 0 kT θ`) with `congr 1` on an application of the coerced `OrthonormalBasis.repr` isometry, leaving the fact unnamed and the step dependent on how that bundled coercion elaborates. Mathlib has no `circleMap` negation lemma to lean on: `circleMap_neg_radius` states `circleMap c (-r) x = circleMap c r (x + π)`.

summary: Proofs are short and automation-friendly with no change/show or defeq abuse, but the sphere-to-norm translation that every transported circle-average lemma needs is duplicated verbatim instead of being a named lemma, and radialVector_neg_radius routes the one real fact through congr 1 on a coerced LinearIsometryEquiv rather than a rewrite.
